text_block_list.text: The race is starting soon! I'm sooo excited!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely take first place and stand center stage at the winning concert! ☆

text_block_list.text: Ehehe… Thank you! ♪ Look forward to the win, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'll show you how cute I am both on the stage and on the track! ☆
